summary_1line: Chyavana praises the sanctity of cows, blesses fishermen to heaven, and Bhishma transitions to Yudhishthira’s questions about Parashurama and Vishvamitra’s lineage.

image_candidates.scene_text: The sage Chyavana raises his hand in blessing as astonished fishermen and the fish in their nets rise together toward heaven.
King Nahusha stands in wonder as radiant fishermen ascend skyward with their nets full of fish.
The aged Bhishma lies on his bed of arrows while Yudhishthira respectfully questions him about the birth and deeds of Rama Jamadagni’s son.
